title: Mapping effective connectivity of human amygdala with intracranial stimulation: es-TT evoked-potential epochs (OSF dngv5)
description: Intracranial EEG evoked-potential epochs recorded during single-pulse electrical stimulation of the human amygdala (electrical stimulation tract-tracing, es-TT) in neurosurgical patients. The dataset includes 11 participants and 46 stimulation runs of roughly 60 epochs each, sampled at 8 kHz. It supports mapping the effective connectivity of amygdala subdivisions, as reported in Sawada et al., Nature Communications 2022.
methods_description: Single-pulse electrical stimulation of the amygdala with simultaneous intracranial recordings from depth, strip and grid electrodes at 8 kHz. Epochs are 2 s (16001 samples) and are time-locked to the stimulus artefact. Channel labels come from patient electrode spreadsheets.
